sourceText: Create a story to migrate the functionality in ~/work/repo/proof-or-stop-graph into our Prooforstop repo, as one of the proof-or-stop commands. Follow-up decisions: use a new packages/graph subpackage; vendored browser bundles are dependency build output and do not enter source; name the command "graph"; then complete the story.
normalizedOutcome: Running proof-or-stop graph inside this repository starts the interactive story and evidence graph that previously required the separate proof-or-stop-graph checkout, serving the d3 graph view, full-text search and per-story detail drawer, while leaving the inspected worktree clean.
acceptanceClaim: proof-or-stop graph is a registered top-level command in this repository that builds from packages/graph and serves the migrated browser client, with the vendored bundles remaining gitignored build output.
